description.narrative: the program Sowing Diversity = Harvesting Security works with partners in eight countries (China, Laos, Nepal, Zambia, Zimbabwe, Uganda, Peru and Guatemala) on better access, use and sharing of plant genetic resources (seeds). The program#s ambition is to contribute to a global food system that is just and sustainable, that supports the rights of small-scale food producers - men and women, that guarantees food and nutrition security and that promotes the sustainable management of natural resources and seed biodiversity within the context of a changing climate. Oxfam in Belgium (OBE) country office in Laos will be responsible for the overall coordination of the project and relationship with partners like ARC/NAFRI, financial and monitoring support, development of gender-sensitive approach, sharing insights in tools, methodsand tactics among organizations that foster Farmers' Rights. It will play a special role to launch new activities that will require specific expertise and work, and to support local organization to facilitate exchange andlearnings with countries in the region or similar sectors.
